title: Approval Command Validation
description: Validates that a human response matches the exact approval command before any G2, G4, G5, or G6 action proceeds. Generation creates a request for authority; it does not create or grant authority.
intent: Pure, replay-safe validation of a single human approval response against the generated approval request and current repository/action readback. The evaluator binds approval_request_id, 16-hex scope_hash_short, gate, target, actor, and expiry exactly; vague, stale, expired, mismatched, unavailable, or already-consumed inputs fail closed. Equivalent replay is idempotent and non-expanding; the validator never grants a higher gate than was validated and never performs the action.
outcome: Typed gate-approval-validation artifact containing schema_version, approval_request_ref, outcome (VALID/INVALID/BLOCKED), approval_valid, consumption_key, reason_codes, primary_reason_code, replay_status (FIRST_SEEN/IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY/REPLAY_CONFLICT), validation_digest (sha256), validated_at, event_id_or_idempotency_key, and all *_authority_granted flags const-false. The validator performs no action and grants no execution, merge, deploy, or production authority.
constraints: The evaluator is pure and deterministic for the same semantic inputs; the validation_digest is over approval_request_id, scope_hash_short, expires_at, and consumption_key.

The human response must match the canonical command grammar APPROVE <GATE_SHORT> <approval_request_id> <scope_hash_short:16hex> <expires_at_utc> extracted from the generated approval_command; extra tokens or grammar deviations fail closed as INPUT_INVALID.
Material drift in scope_hash, base_sha, head_sha, repository, action, target, actor, or expiry invalidates prior evidence and requires re-validation.
Validations are single-consumption; idempotent replay under the same event/idempotency key returns IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY; cross-event reuse of a consumed request returns ALREADY_CONSUMED.
The validator must never grant G2, G4, G5, G6, merge, deploy, release, credential, migration, or production-data authority; all *_authority_granted fields are const false.
Readback UNAVAILABLE is a BLOCKED outcome (not an invalid-human-approval), so the approval is not consumed.
exclusions: Granting or performing any gate transition, merge, deploy, release, migration, or production-data operation.
Issuing, minting, or consuming approvals; token generation is the consumer node gate_authority.approval-token-generation.
Writing to repositories, Jira, GitHub, branches, worktrees, PRs, or production data.
Authority-plane modifications outside the explicit task scope.
entry_guards: current_readback is available and bound to the repository/action
current_readback.branch and pr_number match the approval request bindings

reason_codes.APPROVAL_VALID: The exact human response matched the generated approval request and current readback; the response may be evaluated by the next authority node.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_INPUT_INVALID: The human response did not match the canonical command grammar or required input was malformed/empty.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_COMMAND_MISMATCH: The request_id, gate, or expiry in the human response did not match the generated approval request exactly.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_TOKEN_MISMATCH: The scope_hash_short in the human response did not match the generated approval request exactly.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The approval response's expiry is at or before the validated_at timestamp.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_NOT_YET_VALID: The approval request's issued_at is after the validated_at timestamp.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_READBACK_UNAVAILABLE: The current readback status is UNAVAILABLE; the approval is not consumed and the outcome is BLOCKED.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_BINDING_MISMATCH: base_sha or repository in the readback did not match the approval request bindings.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_SCOPE_DRIFT: scope_hash in the readback did not match the approval request scope_hash.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_HEAD_DRIFT: head_sha in the readback did not match the approval request bindings head_sha.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_PR_STATE_INVALID: For G4, the PR is not open, is a draft, is closed/merged, or PR head_sha does not match.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_ALREADY_CONSUMED: The approval request was already consumed by a different event/idempotency key.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_REPLAY_CONFLICT: A prior validation produced a non-idempotent conflicting outcome for the same idempotency key.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_G5_SCOPE_INVALID: A G5 deploy response was made against a status-only or production-applicable=false action.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_G6_SCOPE_INVALID: A G6 response was made without production scope applicability or environment mismatch.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_ACTOR_MISMATCH: The current_actor in the readback did not match the approval_request.actor_target exactly.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_ACTOR_MISSING: The approval request does not contain a valid actor_target.
reason_codes.APPROVAL_TARGET_MISMATCH: The current action, branch, or pr_number in the readback did not match the approval request bindings exactly.
